text: Stepdaughter, 5, temp 39.8. Sick once this evening but kept all her drinks down since. Hasn't pooed in 3 days and she's grumpy about it. Neck's fine, she can look down at her feet. She's got red spots on her legs but they're mosquito bites, she was out in the garden all day getting eaten alive and scratching them. I'm terrified, what should I do?
